class.name: XboxNetworking
class.description:
Wraps the [code]XNetworking[/code] family: the preferred local UDP multiplayer port, connectivity hints, Network Security Allow List (NSAL) information for title endpoints, and the TCP queued-receive-buffer configuration and statistics surfaces. All methods return [XboxResult] with the success payload in [code]XboxResult.data[/code]; [code]*_async[/code] methods return a [Signal] to [code]await[/code] that completes with an [XboxResult]. [b]Windows behavior:[/b] [method query_configuration_setting], [method set_configuration_setting], and [method query_statistics] are documented no-ops on Windows — the setter reports [code]E_NOTIMPL[/code] and the queries report zeros. They are wrapped so the surface is identical on console-capable Godot forks. [b]Not wrapped:[/b] [code]XNetworkingVerifyServerCertificate[/code] requires a WinHTTP [code]HINTERNET[/code] request handle from [code]WinHttpOpenRequest[/code], which Godot's HTTP classes do not expose, so it cannot be called correctly from GDScript. Read the thumbprints from [XboxNetworkingSecurityInformation] and validate in native code instead. [code]XNetworkingQuerySecurityInformationForUrlUtf16Async[/code] differs from the UTF-8 entry point only in input encoding, which is not observable through Godot's single [String] type. [codeblock] var init: XboxResult = GDK.initialize() if not init.is_ok(): push_error(init.message) return
GDK.networking.connectivity_hint_changed.connect(func(hint: Dictionary) -> void: print("network ready: ", hint["network_initialized"], " level: ", hint["connectivity_level_name"]))
var port_result: XboxResult = await GDK.networking.query_preferred_local_udp_multiplayer_port_async() if port_result.is_ok(): print("bind multiplayer UDP socket to port ", port_result.data["port"]) [/codeblock]

method.name: query_preferred_local_udp_multiplayer_port
method.description: Returns the preferred local UDP port for multiplayer traffic (3074 by default), in host byte order. Wraps [code]XNetworkingQueryPreferredLocalUdpMultiplayerPort[/code]. On success [code]data[/code] is a [Dictionary] with [code]port: int[/code]. The GDK documents this synchronous call as unsafe on time-sensitive threads, which Godot's main thread is. Prefer [method query_preferred_local_udp_multiplayer_port_async] from [code]_ready()[/code] or [code]_process()[/code] and keep this overload for worker threads and startup code. Returns [code]not_initialized[/code] before [method GDK.initialize], or [code]preferred_local_udp_multiplayer_port_failed[/code] on HRESULT failure.

method.name: query_preferred_local_udp_multiplayer_port_async
method.description: Asynchronous form of [method query_preferred_local_udp_multiplayer_port], safe to start from the main thread. Wraps [code]XNetworkingQueryPreferredLocalUdpMultiplayerPortAsync[/code] and [code]XNetworkingQueryPreferredLocalUdpMultiplayerPortAsyncResult[/code]. Completes with an [XboxResult] whose [code]data[/code] is a [Dictionary] with [code]port: int[/code]. Fails with [code]not_initialized[/code] before [method GDK.initialize], [code]preferred_local_udp_multiplayer_port_start_failed[/code] when the request cannot be started, or [code]preferred_local_udp_multiplayer_port_failed[/code] when it completes in error.

method.name: get_connectivity_hint
method.description: Returns the current connectivity hint. Wraps [code]XNetworkingGetConnectivityHint[/code]; safe to call on the main thread. On success [code]data[/code] is a [Dictionary] with [code]connectivity_level: int[/code] (one of [enum ConnectivityLevelHint]), [code]connectivity_level_name: String[/code], [code]connectivity_cost: int[/code] (one of [enum ConnectivityCostHint]), [code]connectivity_cost_name: String[/code], [code]iana_interface_type: int[/code], [code]network_initialized: bool[/code], [code]approaching_data_limit: bool[/code], [code]over_data_limit: bool[/code], and [code]roaming: bool[/code]. [code]network_initialized[/code] is the only authoritative field. Everything else is a best-effort, device-wide hint and must not be treated as a reachability test for a specific endpoint — attempt the connection and use the hint only to explain a failure. Returns [code]not_initialized[/code] before [method GDK.initialize], or [code]connectivity_hint_failed[/code] on HRESULT failure.

method.name: query_security_information_for_url_async
method.description: Queries the Network Security Allow List (NSAL) entry for [param url], which must be a title endpoint registered in Partner Center. Wraps [code]XNetworkingQuerySecurityInformationForUrlAsync[/code], [code]XNetworkingQuerySecurityInformationForUrlAsyncResultSize[/code], and [code]XNetworkingQuerySecurityInformationForUrlAsyncResult[/code]. Completes with an [XboxResult] whose [code]data[/code] is an [XboxNetworkingSecurityInformation]. Fails with [code]not_initialized[/code] before [method GDK.initialize], [code]invalid_url[/code] for an empty URL, [code]security_information_start_failed[/code] when the request cannot be started, or [code]security_information_size_failed[/code] / [code]security_information_failed[/code] when it completes in error.

method.name: query_configuration_setting
method.description: Reads a TCP queued-receive-buffer configuration setting. Wraps [code]XNetworkingQueryConfigurationSetting[/code]. On success [code]data[/code] is a [Dictionary] with [code]value: int[/code] and [code]unlimited: bool[/code]. [code]unlimited[/code] is the authoritative flag: it is [code]true[/code] when the native [code]uint64[/code] value is [code]UINT64_MAX[/code], which GDScript's signed [int] reports as [code]-1[/code]. Any other value above [code]INT64_MAX[/code] is clamped to [code]INT64_MAX[/code] rather than wrapping negative. Always reports [code]0[/code] and [code]false[/code] on Windows, where these settings are a documented no-op. Returns [code]not_initialized[/code] before [method GDK.initialize], [code]invalid_configuration_setting[/code] for unknown values, or [code]configuration_setting_query_failed[/code] on HRESULT failure.

method.name: set_configuration_setting
method.description: Writes a TCP queued-receive-buffer configuration setting. Wraps [code]XNetworkingSetConfigurationSetting[/code]. [param value] must be zero or greater. On success [code]data[/code] is a [Dictionary] echoing [code]setting[/code] and [code]value[/code]. On Windows this always fails with [code]not_supported_on_platform[/code] ([code]E_NOTIMPL[/code]), which is the documented behavior rather than a real error. Returns [code]not_initialized[/code] before [method GDK.initialize], [code]invalid_configuration_setting[/code] for unknown settings, [code]invalid_configuration_value[/code] for negative values, or [code]configuration_setting_set_failed[/code] on other HRESULT failures.

method.name: query_statistics
method.description: Reads TCP queued-receive-buffer usage statistics. Wraps [code]XNetworkingQueryStatistics[/code]. On success [code]data[/code] is a [Dictionary] with [code]num_bytes_currently_queued[/code], [code]peak_num_bytes_ever_queued[/code], [code]total_num_bytes_queued[/code], [code]num_bytes_dropped_for_exceeding_configured_max[/code], and [code]num_bytes_dropped_due_to_any_failure[/code]. Succeeds but always reports zeros on Windows, where these statistics are a documented no-op. Returns [code]not_initialized[/code] before [method GDK.initialize], [code]invalid_statistics_type[/code] for unknown values, or [code]statistics_query_failed[/code] on HRESULT failure.

signal.name: preferred_local_udp_multiplayer_port_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the preferred local UDP multiplayer port changes, and once shortly after [method GDK.initialize] with the current value — the GDK fires an initial callback on registration, so the first emission reports current state rather than a change. A socket bound to the previous port stops receiving inbound traffic from new peers, so titles should rebind when this fires. Delivered on the main thread during [method GDK.dispatch].

signal.name: connectivity_hint_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the device connectivity hint changes, and once shortly after [method GDK.initialize] with the current value for the same reason as [signal preferred_local_udp_multiplayer_port_changed]. [param hint] has the same shape as the [method get_connectivity_hint] payload. Delivered on the main thread during [method GDK.dispatch].
